title: Search returns empty list despite matching documents
body:
## Description
During a recorded session in DocFinder, the user encountered: Search returns empty list despite matching documents.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Observe UI state: Search documents
2. Observe UI state: 0 results
3. Observe UI state: Filter: All types

## Expected Behavior
The application should complete the user flow without errors.

## Actual Behavior
The session shows failure indicators including: Filter: All types.

## Environment
- App: DocFinder
- Platform: web
